prompt:
Create a faithful generated game asset for Lurker, exact incarnation Resident Evil 0 (2002). Use the attached verified references only. Preserve the precise head, anatomy, proportions, costume, equipment, material colours and asymmetric details. Do not mix games, phases or editions. Match the source appearance without added cartoon outlines, coloured halos or decoration. One subject only, no text, labels, scenery, floor, montage or frame. Clean transparent alpha. This remains a generated adaptation, not an original Capcom frame or a geometric 1:1 certificate. One complete full-body static combat idle base pose, facing right in a side/three-quarter fighting-game view. Keep every source-documented limb, foot, tail, wing, tentacle, horn and equipment inside the image with generous transparent padding. Preserve actual locomotion and support points; do not turn a quadruped or aquatic creature into a humanoid. Produce the entire body in this one image, not separate pieces. No motion blur, duplicate bodies or animation-frame grid. Only proceed after actually reviewing a complete source body reference.
Use the source frog anatomy and four digit-bearing limbs. A low four-limbed crouched ready stance, mouth and head pointing clearly to screen RIGHT, with the existing tongue entirely visible. Do not make it a humanoid or an upright biped.
Composition requirement: at least ten percent transparent padding around EVERY anatomical and equipment endpoint. A clear RIGHT-facing side or three-quarter fighting-game base idle. One body only; no animation grid. Preserve source asymmetries rather than using a software mirror.
sourceObservation: Complete frog-like source silhouette with tongue, four splayed limbs and clawed ends is visible; native-model source angles are additionally available and will be reviewed before body generation.
